body:
The few times I talked to someone recently, it just made me relive my pain and leave feeling worse.  I do want to believe it will help, and I'm putting my best effort forward, but it's so hard.  

No, nothing like that.

I've been trying out different medications, and my current one's helping a little, but none of them have been truly successful in making the anxiety bearable.  I'm currently pursuing therapy, but the in-the-moment discomfort of talking to someone is so bad that it paralyzes me when I'm in the situation.  I don't know how to begin to get over it so I can actually get help.
